blockers.description: Official v4.3.1 document bodies and per-page content hashes are not retained.
Generated Sphinx/API documentation has not been reproduced from the exact release.
Rolling-site statements and documented command conflicts are not resolved into the exact v4.3.1 source authority.

limitations: The project license does not establish rights or safe handling for calculator outputs, pseudopotentials, datasets, third-party dependencies, or generated execution artifacts.
The exact source-document inventory does not establish the installed phonopy version, calculator executable behavior, force identity, numerical convergence, or scientific acceptance.

External raw identity is the SHA-256 of canonical sorted git ls-tree -r receipt lines '<mode> <object_type> <object_id>\t<path>\n' for every inventory entry; the local inventory JSON is metadata evidence only and contains no official document body bytes.

losses.description: Only exact Git path and object metadata are retained; documentation bodies remain external.
The Sphinx/API build and generated command-reference surface have not been reproduced from the exact v4.3.1 release.
The current rolling website may describe versions newer than v4.3.1; rolling pages are not normalized into the exact-release authority.

Phonopy documentation conflict 'main-cli-nac' (blocking-for-command-generation): The generic command-options and some interface pages still list --nac, while the v4 migration page says it was removed from the main phonopy CLI; NAC is automatic and --nonac is the opt-out.

Phonopy documentation conflict 'force-collection-command' (blocking-for-stale-example): Interface subsections on the command-options page retain phonopy -f examples, but v4 rejects setup flags on phonopy.

Phonopy documentation conflict 'example-output-version' (nonblocking-with-disclosure): The current 4.3.1 Examples page embeds output banners from 2.26.6 and warns that website examples can lag package examples.
Phonopy documentation conflict 'propplot-spelling' (nonblocking-typo): The auxiliary-tools page heading and source entrypoint say phonopy-propplot, while its example says phonopy-proplot.

Phonopy documentation conflict 'pypolymlp-version-and-options' (blocking-for-mlp-recipe): A temperature-dependent-force-constants page contains dependency and option text that does not match the v4.3.1 pyproject/parser baseline.

Phonopy documentation conflict 'random-displacement-legacy-cli' (blocking-for-stale-example): The random-displacement page retains setup examples with phonopy --rd ... -c --dim even though v4 moved initial setup to phonopy-init.
Phonopy documentation conflict 'qe-born-nac' (blocking-for-stale-example): QE/BORN prose retains phonopy --nac examples although the v4 main parser removed --nac.

Phonopy documentation conflict 'vasp-born-st' (blocking-for-option-generation): VASP prose refers to phonopy-vasp-born --st, but the pinned helper defaults to symmetrization and exposes --nost instead.
Phonopy documentation conflict 'pdos-filename' (nonblocking-with-explicit-input): Output documentation names projected_dos.dat while helper source/help may use partial_dos.dat as a default.

Phonopy documentation conflict 'qha-exclude-imaginary' (blocking-without-volume-accounting): The pinned QHA parser contains --exclude-imaginary but the official QHA prose does not fully document its scientific consequences.

Phonopy documentation conflict 'calculator-index-lag' (nonblocking-discovery-drift): The official interface navigation does not match all 17 calculator selectors in the pinned parser, including PWmat.
Phonopy documentation conflict 'bandplot-gnuplot-exit' (adapter-special-case): The pinned phonopy-bandplot --gnuplot path can emit requested data and then exit with status 1.
Phonopy documentation conflict 'installation-scipy' (nonblocking-environment-drift): The install page lists SciPy, but the v4.3.1 core dependency manifest does not.
Phonopy documentation conflict 'no-console-version-flag' (blocking-for-version-probe): The pinned console parsers do not register --version, and phonopy -v means verbose.
Phonopy documentation conflict 'removed-shortcuts' (blocking-for-option-generation): Common tutorial-era shortcuts --symfc and --br are absent from the v4.3.1 parser.
